records.subject: You're in -- let's get Maple Dynamics set up
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Maple Dynamics' setup
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for the reply earlier this week. Whenever you're ready, I'm happy to help with the first step.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the thing that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when it's useful, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week suit you to get that first project mapped out together?

Best,
Priya
